name: Megan Nicole Dong
bio:
Megan Nicole Dong is the creator and executive producer of Centaurworld. Her other credits include: writing and composing many of the series' songs, directing and storyboarding the episode Hello Rainbow Road including the sequence for Rider's Lullaby, storyboarding for The Last Lullaby including the sequence for Who Was She, and providing the voice of Glendale.

Centaurworld is her first animated series as creator and showrunner. The show is produced by her studio Sketchshark Productions.

Her past roles include: director and storyboarding for Pinky Malinky, story artist for How to Train Your Dragon 2 (2014), story artist for Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie (2017), and layout artist for Metalocalypse.

In June 2023, it was announced that she would directing a new animated feature for WB animation titled Bad Fairies, to be produced by Locksmith Animation.

credits.title: Bad Fairies
credits.overview: Hidden beneath the streets of modern London exists a secret magical world powered by an ancient code that fairies have followed for centuries. But when a fearless gang of rule-breaking fairies accidentally transforms an ordinary tween into a fairy, they uncover a far bigger problem: the magic system itself is failing.

credits.title: We Lost Our Human
credits.overview: There's been a glitch — all the humans are gone! Can you help pampered pet siblings Pud and Ham journey to the center of the universe to fix it?
